newsitem.title: UK: Hogg Robinson says will not meet forecasts.
newsitem.headline: Hogg Robinson says will not meet forecasts.

text.p: British travel and financial services firm Hogg Robinson Plc said on Tuesday it did not expect to meet analysts' current expectations for the year ending in March.
Hogg Robinson said the strong pound was affecting its European activities, particularly in the transport division.

The company said Bennett, its Nordic-based travel business, was likely to see a profit below expectations because of rising competition, lower than expected sales and a squeeze on margins. Hogg Robinson said trading in the British market for travel and financial services was broadly in line with plans.
